text:
eden: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread — consolidating action items for GPU capacity + autoscaling. Observed: repeated slow scale-ups (avg 45s), two quota rejections, nightly eval spikes. Proposed items below.

sarah: I'll own cloud quota request (GCP GPUs) and follow-up with acct team. Opening ticket INF-7123, target EOW (Fri). @accts-ops FYI.

mike: I'll run scheduler tuning experiments. Plan: lower pod start backoff and bump kube-scheduler podBatchTimeout. Proposed config:
```
scheduler:
  maxPodStartDelay: 60s
  preemptionTimeout: 30s
  backoff: 5s
```
I'll post perf numbers by Wed.

lina: Product asks for hard burst cap per-customer. Recommend 20% headroom reserved in Dedicated pools to absorb bursts. We should quantify with 4 weeks of telemetry.

ryan: We need new alerting and runbook: alert when scale latency > 30s for >5m. Query to detect:
```
# Prometheus
max(scaled_seconds{job="autoscaler"}) by (pool)
```
Runbook PR: infra/runbooks/gpu-autoscale.md — I'll draft.

deploy-bot: Deployment notice: scheduled canary for autoscaler tune set for 1768270000. Will post results.

eden: Action item list (owner — ETA):
- Quota request (sarah) — Fri
- Scheduler experiment + PR (mike) — Wed
- Headroom policy proposal (lina) — next Tue
- Alert + runbook update (ryan) — Thu
- Nightly job throttling (product + eng) — next sprint

mike: Noted pattern: spikes align with nightly eval job at 02:00 UTC. Suggest adding jitter and stagger windows.

sarah: Quick note: cloud quota requires justification doc. I'll attach usage graphs to INF-7123.

lina: Also want retrospective note on recurring incidents section; add to PM postmortem doc.

ryan: Small logs from yesterday for reference:
```
E0321 02:03:12 podscheduler.go:201] failed to schedule: no nodes available with nvidia.com/gpu
E0321 02:03:13 autoscaler.go:87] scale-up started but no capacity, backoff triggered
```

eden: OK — I'll create a single tracker issue to follow these (INF-7200) and assign owners. Please update the tracker when you have PRs/tickets. :thumbsup:

mike: Will update when experiment runs.

sarah: Filed quota ticket and emailed accounts. LINK: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7123

ryan: Draft runbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/843

lina: Adding headroom telemetry dashboard to the backlog.

eden: Thanks all. We'll sync on Tuesday sync to close blockers.
